resolutions.note: Adds an on-page note from Rieder, delivered by a boy from the Gemeindehaus, that explicitly cites Art. 48 Abs. 2 and pending formalities and asks Stettler for patience.
Stettler now explicitly wonders whether his confession lies unopened in a drawer because an article permits it, and whether the request for patience masks a decision already made.
The lit-window observation is immediately followed by Stettler's own thought tying it to 'seinem Papier', making the suspicion form on the page.
